[PREFERENCE] User thinks sawing someone in half is a classic magic trick.  
[USER] User is baffled by how the sawing trick is performed without hurting the person.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Explanation of the sawing illusion:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant lies on a table with their feet and head sticking out.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The magician slides a saw blade through a gap in the table.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant's body is concealed in hidden compartments in the table.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The saw blade is either moving between compartments or is not sharp.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Modern performances may use a specially-designed saw blade with no teeth
